### Unearthing Our Walk with Christ
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/article-library/unearthing-our-walk-with-christ
Passage: Colossians 2:6-7
Points:
- Over time, spiritual simplicity can easily become buried under human traditions, expectations, and clutter.
- Spiritual maturity requires establishing deep roots by continually returning to the basics of faith.
- Daily reading of God's Word transforms our thinking and renews our daily walk.
- Drawing near to Christ removes the accumulated debris and allows His life to animate ours.

### Walking in Christ Jesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/walking-christ-jesus
Passage: Colossians 2:6-7
Points:
- Standing firm against false teaching requires grounding ourselves in the apostolic doctrine already delivered.
- Walking in Christ means submitting to His lordship in every area of life.
- True Christian obedience flows from heartfelt gratitude for grace rather than mechanical rule-keeping.
- A lifestyle of thankfulness preserves believers in gospel light and guards against discontent.

### Our Debt Has Been Paid
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-13-2024.html
Passage: Colossians 2:13-14
Points:
- Christ died on the cross to fully settle the insurmountable debt of our sin.
- Fear often keeps guilty people hiding from God until they realize He offers unmerited pardon.
- Through Jesus' sacrifice, the legal charges against us are completely wiped away and canceled.
- Believers no longer live as anxious debtors, but as secure, adopted children of God.

### Satan Disarmed, Sin Forgiven, Soul Alive
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/satan-disarmed-sin-forgiven-soul-alive
Passage: Colossians 2:13-15
Points:
- Spiritual life begins when God forgives our trespasses and erases our condemning debt.
- Christ took the legal record of our failures and nailed it permanently to the cross.
- Demonic powers are disarmed because the cross removed unforgiven sin, their only weapon to damn us.
- Safe from both divine wrath and Satan's accusations, Christians can walk in fearless confidence.
